title: Hearty Irish Fish Tagine
description: A flavorful and comforting pescatarian dish featuring melted butter and a variety of spices, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. This recipe is cooked in a tagine vessel, also known as a tagliere.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large tagine vessel, combine the chopped onion, minced garlic, and melted butter.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes to the tagine vessel, stirring to combine.
Place the cod fillets on top of the vegetables, sprinkling with thyme, pepper, and salt.
Pour the chicken broth over the cod fillets, making sure they are covered.
Cover the tagine vessel with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the cod is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Remove the tagine vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the hearty Irish fish tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
